text:
maria_infra: heads up — ap-southeast-1a GPU fleet is spiking single-bit ECC and I've seen 3 node reboots in the last 20m. nodes: gpu-aps1a-07[3-5].
infra-bot: Alert: ECC_RATE_HIGH for cluster=prod-aps1a scope=gpu-pool (95th percentile ECC errors increased x7)
jared_hw: can you paste the node IDs & last kernel oops logs? will start a support ticket with vendor if reboots continue :+1:
maria_infra: logs attached (snippet):
```
[ 1024.512345] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=0, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1024.512678] kernel: GPU ecc single-bit error @ BAR0 offset 0x1f0
[ 1025.002111] kubelet: Eviction threshold breached for pod model-serving-xyz
```
lucy_oncall: thanks — I see the autoscaler already made 2 attempts to reschedule. Suspect transient PCI resets -> need to drain gracefully before we get NG failures.
nana_sre: tagging @tom_platform — do we have spare capacity in region to absorb traffic? also any Dedicated customers pinned to these nodes?
tom_platform: we have 6 spare GPU instances in aps1 region, but 2 are reserved for long-running Dedicated reservations. Effective spare=4. If we shift traffic to eu-west it adds ~40-60ms median latency for some endpoints.
sanjay: prioritize customer SLAs — shift non-Dedicated routes first. We should drain affected nodes and set routing weight down for aps1 for stateless models.
maria_infra: plan proposal:
1) cordon + drain gpu-aps1a-073, gpu-aps1a-074, gpu-aps1a-075 with `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`
2) set router policy: ap-southeast-1 weight -> 0.5 (gradually to 0.2 if errors persist)
3) enable fallback to quantized model variants for latency-critical paths
4) open RMA ticket for the 3 nodes if any further reboots
any objections?
lucy_oncall: +1. I'll run the drains and watch pod reschedules. I'll add `--grace-period=120` so stateful jobs can checkpoint.
infra-bot: Executing drain: gpu-aps1a-073 by lucy_oncall at 1784123500
lucy_oncall: drain started for gpu-aps1a-073. Will post pod eviction progress.
lucy_oncall: eviction summary: 12 pods evicted, 2 failed but restarted on other nodes. CPU pressure briefly spiked to 85% on target nodes.
sanjay: start the routing adjustment now. Command (platform console):
```
redwood routing update --region ap-southeast-1 --weight 0.5 --service model-gen
```
tom_platform: applied weight=0.5. Watch metrics: token latency and error-rate on eu-west 10s after change.
maria_infra: seeing ECC counts decrease on gpu-aps1a-073 after drain. gpu-aps1a-074 still noisy.
jared_hw: ordered RMA for gpu-serials: SN-A1B2C3, SN-A1B2C4, SN-A1B2C5. ETA parts ~72 hours. For urgent capacity we can failover to eu-west or spin up ephemeral nodes in ap-southeast-1b (hot spare AZ).
nana_sre: can we avoid cross-region shifts for Dedicated tenants? they require data locality — need to confirm which routes are pinned.
maria_infra: confirmed: two Dedicated customers pinned to pool-dedicated-aps1, those won't be moved. We'll drain only in the shared GPU pool `gpu-shared-aps1`.
lucy_oncall: starting drain gpu-aps1a-074 now. `kubectl annotate node gpu-aps1a-074 maintenance=true` so autoscaler doesn't refill with new pods.
infra-bot: node gpu-aps1a-074 cordoned by lucy_oncall
maria_infra: note: if we lower ap-southeast-1 weight below 0.3, cost to route to eu-west increases egress and inter-region traffic — finance FYI: expect +$3-5k/day if we keep long term.
finance-alert-bot: Noted. Send estimate to finance-runbook channel if >$10k/week.
sanjay: we'll keep shift temporary. If failures continue past 6h, we move to plan B: spin up ap-southeast-1b ephemeral fleet (n1-highgpu style) and thinly migrate models.
lucy_oncall: drain complete for gpu-aps1a-074. 0 pods remaining. Monitoring health.
maria_infra: gpu-aps1a-075 shows kernel oops during last drain attempt — it's in a crash loop. I'm marking it `taint` so scheduler ignores: `kubectl taint nodes gpu-aps1a-075 node.kubernetes.io/unreachable=true:NoSchedule`
jared_hw: I'll prepare the swap: cold replace node and perform hardware diagnostics. If board looks flaky, we'll RMA full node.
nana_sre: please document steps for postmortem. Capture: timeline, impacted customers, routing change timestamps, cost delta, RMA ticket refs.
lucy_oncall: quick status update: metrics look stable after takes weight->0.4 over 15m. ECC error-rate trending down to baseline.
maria_infra: thanks everyone. I'll keep the thread updated if any reboots recur. Next steps: complete RMA, reimage replacement nodes, and run burn-in for 24h before returning to pool. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: Incident note created: INC-aps1a-2026-03-18 by maria_infra
tom_platform: prepping a short runbook snippet for ops to reuse:
```
1) Detect ECC spike -> alert infra channel
2) Identify affected nodes via `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.total,serial,ecc.errors` (script attached)
3) Cordon + drain affected nodes
4) Reduce region routing weight incrementally
5) If reboots persist, escalate to hardware RMA
6) Return nodes to pool after 24h burn-in
```
lucy_oncall: adding runbook to /docs/ops/incidents/gpu-ecc-evacuations.md
maria_infra: closing note: if no reboots in 72h we'll mark incident resolved and restore full routing weight. Thanks :hands_together:
